A.title: Structurally Aligned Subtask-Level Memory for Software Engineering Agents
A.memory_unit: triple m=(z,d,e): category z in {Analyze,Reproduce,Edit,Verify}; description d=objective+keywords; abstracted experience e
A.retrieval_rule: category hard-filter -> semantic Top-1 (forced; no threshold; no abstention)
A.update_rule: per-subtask extraction of reusable success pattern / failure-avoidance experience
A.seeds: 3 independent runs, shuffled order over 500 instances; Avg. Pass@1 mean +/- std
